tools.name: signalshelf_profile
tools.description: Return a normalized public profile and cache/cost metadata. Default demo mode is illustrative and free. Explicit live mode charges one credit only for a successful fresh fetch; accepted cache hits and failures cost zero. Public-page engines can be blocked or incomplete.

tools.name: signalshelf_batch
tools.description: Validate all profile inputs before fetching any. Returns per-item successes/errors. Each successful fresh live item costs one credit; demos/cache hits/failures cost zero. Maximum ten items, processed sequentially.

tools.name: signalshelf_resource
tools.description: Fetch any implemented public resource found with signalshelf_capabilities — TikTok, Instagram, Threads, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest, Spotify, Google Maps/Search/News, app stores, Amazon, Trustpilot, ad libraries and more (platform "web", resource = op key like "tiktok/video/com

tools.name: signalshelf_capabilities
tools.description: Search SignalShelf operations (~250 across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Google Maps, reviews, ad libraries…). Pass query and/or platform to get matching operations with full parameter schemas and credit prices; with no filters returns a compact index. No source fetches and zero

tools.name: signalshelf_credits
tools.description: Read the authenticated account’s current database balance. Zero credits. No other account details or API keys are returned.

tools.name: signalshelf_usage
tools.description: Read up to 100 recent lookup events belonging to the authenticated account, without source payloads, account IDs, or secrets. Zero credits.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "signalshelf_usage" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
